subject: Request: Hosted API prepay + long-term commit — pricing exception
messages:
From: Sorin Popescu <sorin@aurorahealth.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-17T09:15:00-08:00
Subject: Hosted API pricing — potential prepay + 12m commit

Hi Kimberly,

Appreciate the demo yesterday — Aurora's data science team ran a quick PoC and we're pretty impressed with latency and embedding stability. We have a procurement window open and are considering a 12-month prepaid commitment across multiple teams.

High-level ask: we need a price that's at least 20% below standard hosted usage rates to make the accounting work for a prepaid FY27 commitment. If we can get to ~22–25% off with a 12-month prepay and a 24M token minimum spend guarantee, we can accelerate to an enterprise PO and a legal-ready SOW within 2 weeks.

Attached a short RFP and our traffic forecast. Can Redwood provide an exec-reviewed concession for a prepay scenario? We also need a statement that usage will be isolated to US regions and that audit logs/retention policy matches our compliance controls.

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call if helpful.

Sorin Popescu
Director, Platform Partnerships
Aurora Health
Attachments: Aurora_RFP_v3.pdf (pdf), Aurora_traffic_forecast.xlsx (xlsx)
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Sorin Popescu <sorin@aurorahealth.ai>, Elena Morales <elena.morales@aurorahealth.ai>
Date: 2026-11-17T10:38:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API pricing — potential prepay + 12m commit

Hi Sorin / Elena,

Really glad the PoC went well — and thanks for the materials. Short answer: we can consider an off-list concession for prepaid, committed volume, but anything beyond our standard 20% commercial guardrail needs senior authorization.

What I can do now:
- Confirm we will honor US-only region restriction and provide SOC2 audit logs retention language in the SOW.
- Build a mutual action plan and put the financial summary in Deal Desk format (I included our internal deal id HSP-9821).
- Submit a formal Exec Approval packet requesting a 22–25% one-time concession tied to a 12-month prepaid commitment and the 24M token minimum.

Next steps from my side: I'll pull together the packet and route to Ben + Marcus for sign-off. Can you confirm the exact PO cadence (one-time prepay vs quarterly invoicing) and whether the forecasted tokens are all production traffic or include research/dev burst allowances? That will affect the tiering.

If you need a call, I have 11–11:30am or 3–4pm PT today.

— Kimberly
Kimberly Park
Account Executive, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
Attachments: none

Ben / Marcus / Priya — forwarding the Aurora thread plus materials. TL;DR: 12-month prepay, 24M token minimum, asks for 22–25% off hosted usage list. Forecast attached shows steady ramp to 3.5M tokens/month in Q1 then scale.

Why this matters: Aurora is an enterprise health-tech prospect with an active procurement window and a multi-product usage pattern (chat + embeddings + reranking). Prepay reduces our churn risk and guarantees volume in a relatively underutilized region cluster. They will require SOC2 logs and US-only routing (we can commit to that).

Proposed concession packet (summary):
- Commercial: 24M token prepay for 12 months, invoiced upfront (one-time).
- Pricing: standard hosted rate less 25% (requesting 25% approval to leave some room on the table).
- Legal: SOW to include US-region routing, audit logs, data retention 90 days (customer requested), and standard DPA.
- Conditions: Early termination clawback on unused tokens prorated over the term; Redwood reserves the right to limit burst capacity above forecasted monthly averages without notice.

Attached: Aurora_RFP_v3.pdf, Aurora_traffic_forecast.xlsx, preliminary MOU draft.

Request: Marcus / Priya — need senior authorization to exceed 20% guardrail. Please advise whether 22–25% is approvable and, if so, any additional commercial constraints you want (e.g., maximum effective discount if usage falls below X). If we have approval, I will prepare the DocuSign + legal SOW with the above conditions.

Thanks — Kimberly

Kimberly / Ben / Priya — reviewed the packet and Aurora's forecast. I appreciate the upfront prepay and regional constraint; this materially reduces our risk and improves utilization. Given Aurora's strategic fit (healthcare vertical, multi-product usage), I approve a one-time 25% off list hosted usage rate for the 12-month prepaid commitment under these conditions:

1) Invoice paid in full within 15 business days of contract signature; funds applied as prepaid credit against hosted token consumption.
2) Clawback: unused tokens at termination will be refunded at 75% of effective per-token price (to protect against churn).
3) Product constraints: US-region-only routing must be enforced; any cross-region usage will be charged at standard list rates.
4) Legal signoff required: Legal to approve the final SOW with DPA and SOC2 attestation language.

Please prep the DocuSign with the MOU and SOW, include the clawback clause, and route to Legal. Kimberly, you can proceed to finalize with Aurora and copy finance for invoicing. Marking deal HSP-9821 as approved in HubSpot.

— Marcus Lin
VP, Commercial Strategy
